title: Related list entry label (relatedLists[].label) has no translation key: a declared tab title cannot be localised
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmRY38EZf38Yy3zthbY

Filed as a `finding` by seat `repo:objectstack#2` from PR #36527's Acceptance note 3 (card #35902 thread), read by the seat on `main`. Not triaged; not claimed.

## What

#35902 added an object-level tab list, `relatedLists`, whose entries may carry `{ list, label, columns }`. The entry's `label` wins over the child field's `relatedListTitle`.

`packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts` has a translation key for the field-level title only (`objects.<child>.fields.<field>.relatedListTitle`, line 263 on `main`). It has none for a `relatedLists[]` entry's `label`. A declared tab title therefore shows its authored text in every locale. The field-level title it overrides could be translated.

## Reading

Measured by schema read only (`grep -n -i relatedList packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts`: only the `relatedListTitle` lines). It is not reproduced in a running app.

## Where the fix likely lands

`domain:spec` (a translation key for the entry label), plus its ui reader that overlays it. Re-check: the grep above gaining a `relatedLists` entry-label key.
